answer: A fresh key is a relic with no inscriptions — zero sealed verdicts behind it. Weight here comes only from quorum-matched grading seals, re-checked on-ledger against consensus, so no opal of borrowed reputation can be minted or handed to a clone. Each identity must grade its own way up from a flat delta of nothing; M sybils repay M times the honest judgment labor, so the attacker's cost rises linearly in the number of fakes.
